people.nameZh: 威廉·湯瑪斯·科斯格雷夫

body.zh-Hant: 科斯格雷夫（1880–1965）生於都柏林，在基督教兄弟會受教育後成為酒館業者。他活躍於新芬黨，自1909年起是都柏林市議會成員。
body.en: W. T. Cosgrave (1880–1965) was born in Dublin, was educated by the Christian Brothers and became a publican. He was active in Sinn Féin and was a member of Dublin Corporation from 1909.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年8月他以新芬黨候選人身分在基爾肯尼市補選勝出；1919年出任地下議會政府的地方政府部長。1922年他成為支持條約派的領袖（後來的 Cumann na nGaedheal），1922至1932年任愛爾蘭自由邦行政委員會主席。
body.en: In August 1917 he won the Kilkenny city by-election as the Sinn Féin candidate, and in 1919 he became minister for local government in the underground Dáil administration. In 1922 he emerged as leader of the pro-Treatyites (later Cumann na nGaedheal) and was president of the executive council of the Irish Free State from 1922 to 1932.

people.name: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa
people.nameZh: 曼努埃爾·戈梅斯·達科斯塔

body.zh-Hant: 戈梅斯·達科斯塔1863年1月14日生於里斯本，是騎兵軍官。直到1915年，他幾乎一直待在印度和非洲（莫桑比克、安哥拉、聖多美）。
body.en: Gomes da Costa was born in Lisbon on 14 January 1863 and was a cavalry officer. Until 1915 he spent almost uninterrupted time in India and Africa (Mozambique, Angola, São Tomé).

body.zh-Hant: 第一共和國任命他為葡萄牙遠征軍第一師師長，法蘭德斯戰役反而提高了他的聲望。1920年代初他涉入陰謀，政府把他派往海外任軍事督察（1922–1924）；回國後他加入共和激進黨。
body.en: The First Republic named him commander of the 1st Division of the Portuguese Expeditionary Corps, and the Flanders campaign reinforced his prestige. In the early 1920s he became involved in conspiracies and the government sent him overseas as a military inspector (1922–1924); on his return he joined the Radical Republican Party.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年5月28日他領導的政變成功；他從布拉加進軍里斯本，接掌內閣主席並以不明言的方式掌有國家元首之位（6月17日至7月9日）。他被宣告廢黜，7月11日被捕並流放亞速爾，後被授元帥，1927年9月獲准返國，1929年12月17日去世。
body.en: The coup he led succeeded on 28 May 1926; he marched from Braga to Lisbon, took over the presidency of the Ministry and, not explicitly, the headship of state (17 June–9 July 1926). He was declared deposed; he was arrested and deported to the Azores on 11 July 1926, was made marshal there, returned in September 1927 and died on 17 December 1929.

heading.zh-Hant: 法學教授與斯洛伐克人民黨
heading.en: Law professor and the Slovak People's Party

body.zh-Hant: 圖卡曾在佩奇、後來在布拉提斯拉瓦大學任法學教授；一戰後成為分離主義的斯洛伐克人民黨書記，並主編該黨的《斯洛伐克人》。他採強硬反捷克路線，並與匈牙利的收復失地運動合作，1923年建立法西斯的「Rodobrana」，1929年被捷克斯洛伐克法院以叛國罪判有罪。
body.en: Tuka was a professor of law at Pécs and later at Bratislava University. After World War I he became secretary of the separatist Slovak People's Party and editor of its publication Slovak. He took a strong anti-Czech line, collaborated with the Hungarian irredenta movement, founded the fascist Rodobrana in 1923, and in 1929 was found guilty of high treason by a Czechoslovak court.

body.en: In the pre-Munich days he renewed his activity in the pro-German radical wing of the People's Party led by Hlinka. He became the ideologist of "independent" Slovakia, its prime minister (1939–44) and foreign minister (from 1940). He was condemned to death by the National Tribunal of Bratislava.

heading.en: Birth, professor and the Republican Party

body.zh-Hant: 馬查多1851年3月28日生於里約熱內盧，1860年全家回葡萄牙。1877年2月28日他被任命為哲學院教授，1893年進亨策·里貝羅內閣任公共工程部長，1903年10月31日加入共和黨，1906至1909年主持該黨執行委員會。
body.en: Bernardino Machado was born in Rio de Janeiro on 28 March 1851, and the family returned to Portugal in 1860. He was appointed professor of the Faculty of Philosophy on 28 February 1877, joined the Hintze Ribeiro government in 1893 as minister of public works, joined the Republican Party on 31 October 1903 and presided over its directory from 1906 to 1909.

body.zh-Hant: 1910年10月5日共和國成立後，他任臨時政府外交部長；1912年1月20日起任駐巴西公使兼大使；1914年2月9日至6月23日任內閣主席兼外交、內政部長，6月23日起至12月12日任內閣主席兼內政部長。
body.en: After the Republic was proclaimed on 5 October 1910 he served as foreign minister in the Provisional Government; from 20 January 1912 he was minister and ambassador in Brazil; from 9 February to 23 June 1914 he was president of the Ministry and minister of foreign affairs and of the interior, then president of the Ministry and interior minister until 12 December 1914.

body.zh-Hant: 1915年8月6日他在議會當選共和國總統，後因西多尼奧·派斯的運動被廢黜並被逐出國境。1921年3月2日至5月23日他再任內閣主席兼內政部長；1925年起再任總統，任期因1926年5月28日的軍事運動而中斷。
body.en: He was elected President of the Republic on 6 August 1915 and was deposed after Sidónio Pais's movement and expelled from the country. From 2 March to 23 May 1921 he was again president of the Ministry and interior minister; from 1925 he was President again, a term interrupted by the military movement of 28 May 1926.

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾法羅（1882年8月20日–1971年2月23日）是巴拿馬政治家，1922至1930年及1933至1936年任駐美公使，1931至1932年任臨時總統，1946年任外交部長。他在1936年談成赫爾－阿爾法羅條約，1959至1964年擔任海牙國際法院成員。
body.en: Ricardo Joaquín Alfaro (20 August 1882–23 February 1971) was a Panamanian statesman who served as minister to the United States (1922–1930; 1933–1936), provisional president (1931–1932) and foreign minister (1946). He negotiated the Hull-Alfaro Treaty (1936) and later sat on the International Court of Justice at The Hague (1959–1964).
